name: Explainer
tagline: A topic, article or script goes in, a narrated animated explainer comes out.
description: A 1–3 minute faceless explainer: a voiceover walks through one idea while drawings, diagrams, big words and numbers appear exactly as they're named. It's for creators, teachers and teams who want to explain something clearly without filming anything. What makes it good: a sharp hook, one idea per scene, and every picture landing on its word.
bring: A topic, an article, notes or a finished script
Optional: brand colours, a logo, facts you want on screen
get: A 1–3 min 16:9 explainer with voiceover, captions, music and sound effects

needs.name: Hyperframes (or your project's video tool), Python 3 and ffmpeg

steps: Turn the topic into one clear idea and a short script
Plan one picture per scene and review them as a storyboard
Record or generate the voice and time every word
Animate each scene so every picture lands on its word
Add captions, music and sound effects
Review each version in FrameJam until it's right
